timing_scope: Prepared packed distinct tiles of one convolution -> dispatch/cache/HLS integer outputs; poison/flush/pointer changes/poll/status/invalidate included. Shape/weight-pointer setup, allocation, host packing, numerical checks and file saving excluded. NO activation, YOLO, camera or network FPS.
fairness: One flush of all input/weight/output buffers before each batch and one invalidate after it in every mode. First command loads weights; remaining tiles reuse them. Input is always reloaded. V1 and V2 single launch once per tile; V2 batch launches once per N tiles.
